title: Tanvi Patri Secures Silver at Youth Olympics After Gripping Final
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Tanvi Patri's silver medal performance at the Youth Olympics marks a significant achievement for the nation in junior badminton.
summary: The 15-year-old Indian shuttler Tanvi Patri won a silver medal at the Youth Olympics, saving six match points in a thrilling final that lasted an hour and 22 minutes against China's Zhang Yi Xin.

title: PV Sindhu: "31 Is The New 21" As She Targets World Tour Finals
indian_angle: India's badminton icon PV Sindhu shares her renewed determination and goals as she re-enters the top-10 rankings.
summary: Indian star PV Sindhu, back in the top-10 at 31, expresses her determination to give her best at the upcoming BWF World Tour Finals, stating "31 is the new 21."

title: Eligibility List Out for 49th Junior National Badminton Championships
indian_angle: The release of the eligibility list is crucial for young Indian shuttlers aspiring to compete in the prestigious national championships in Sikkim.
summary: The eligibility list for the Yonex-Sunrise 49th Junior National Badminton Championships 2026, scheduled from November 14th to 21st in Sikkim, has been released.

title: National Camp Underway for BWF World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: India's top junior talent is currently training at NCE Guwahati in preparation for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo, Egypt.
summary: A national coaching camp is being held at the National Center of Excellence, Guwahati, for Indian players selected to represent the country at the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Badminton Association of India Forms New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee aims to give Indian players a stronger voice in the sport's governance and decision-making.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, a significant step towards greater player involvement in the sport's administration.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Implemented in Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will impact young Indian players competing in national and ranking tournaments across various junior age groups.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
